bio_en: I am a PhD student in the Department of Microbiology, School of Life Sciences, Fudan University, with an expected graduation date of June 2029. My research interests span viral evolution, genomic epidemiology and computational approaches to emerging infectious diseases. I combine research experience at the University of Hong Kong with industry experience in bioinformatics, including transcriptomics, single-cell analysis and genomic data analysis workflows.
bio_zh: 我现为复旦大学生命科学学院微生物系博士研究生，预计于2029年6月毕业。研究兴趣包括病毒进化、基因组流行病学，以及新发传染病研究中的计算方法。此前在香港大学从事科研工作，并在生物技术企业积累了转录组、单细胞分析和基因组数据分析流程开发经验。

bullets_en: Developed analysis methods for BCL6, BCL2 and MYC gene fusions in DLBCL sequencing workflows, addressing discrepancies between NGS and FISH results.
Established low-depth whole-genome sequencing workflows for copy-number analysis using QDNAseq, Control-FREEC and ichorCNA.
Built upstream and downstream single-cell RNA-seq workflows and collaborated with IT colleagues to deploy analyses on an automated platform.
Developed RNA-seq expression-based models for leukemia molecular subtyping.
bullets_zh: 围绕弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤测序中的BCL6、BCL2和MYC基因融合检测，开发分析方法，改善NGS与FISH结果的一致性。
搭建低深度全基因组测序拷贝数分析流程，整合QDNAseq、Control-FREEC和ichorCNA。
构建单细胞RNA测序上下游分析流程，与IT团队协作完成自动化平台部署。
基于RNA-seq表达谱开发白血病分子分型预测模型。

bullets_en: Conducted bioinformatics analyses of viral evolution and genomic epidemiology, with a focus on influenza and RSV.
Integrated genomic, clinical and immunological datasets and contributed to collaborative research publications.
bullets_zh: 开展病毒进化与基因组流行病学的生物信息学分析，关注流感与呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）。
整合基因组、临床及免疫学数据，参与合作研究与论文发表。
